desc:
Start as a noob and evolve into DOOM! 🟢

🪄 Train on Magic rings to get +1 Magic... then MORE!
🛡️ Build your armor piece by piece: Iron Mask, Gauntlets, Half Armor, Full Armor
😈 Fight enemies and giant bosses across 30 stages and 2 worlds
💥 Unleash 14 special moves and epic boss finishers
🏆 Earn Wins to Evolve through 20 forms, all the way to God Emperor
🥚 Hatch pets for huge boosts and collect them all
👥 Play with friends for +10% Magic each (up to +50%)
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime gifts and a FREE aura

🎟️ CODES: RELEASE
👥 Join the group for a FREE x2 Magic ring!
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
